title: バス停標識
description: 重量コンクリートの丸い台座に立つ、移動可能なバス停標識です。灰色の支柱と頭部キャップ、両面の丸い標識板と青い縁、取付金具、透明カバー付きの時刻表ケースを造形しています。停留所名・路線番号・時刻表・事業者名などの文字や図記号は含まず、無地の面として残しています。 時刻表カバーはGLB内の半透明（アルファブレンド）材質です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.572 × 2.565 × 0.572 m、4,836三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A movable bus stop pole on a weighted round concrete base. It models the grey pole and cap, a double-sided round flag sign with a blue rim, clamps, and a timetable case with a clear cover. Stop names, route numbers, timetables, operator branding, lettering and symbols are intentionally absent; sign faces and the timetable panel are blank. The timetable cover uses an alpha-blended GLB material. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.572 × 2.565 × 0.572 m; 4,836 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
